description: NFX-17: kind-20465 events at 'now'. Every 'rejected' event MUST be refused by a reader, whether it is an ask or a tell. 'ignored' MUST be dropped without error by a reader (a type this version does not use); a scoped relay that admits lookups refuses it. 'reason' is informative.

rejected.name: ask-a-not-a-manifest
rejected.reason: `a` does not address a kind-38504 manifest

rejected.name: ask-bad-id
rejected.reason: the id is not the NIP-01 hash

rejected.name: tell-content-too-large
rejected.reason: content over 16384 bytes, though it is a valid beacon

rejected.name: tell-embedded-whitespace
rejected.reason: the embedded beacon is not compact

rejected.name: tell-embedded-reordered
rejected.reason: the embedded beacon's members are out of order

rejected.name: tell-embedded-extra-member
rejected.reason: the embedded beacon has a member NIP-01 does not

rejected.name: tell-embedded-duplicate-member
rejected.reason: the embedded beacon repeats a member

rejected.name: tell-beacon-newer-than-the-tell
rejected.reason: the embedded beacon is dated after the tell

rejected.name: tell-beacon-from-the-future
rejected.reason: a beacon NFX-03 accepts, dated 15 min ahead, would hold a table slot

rejected.name: tell-embeds-another-kind
rejected.reason: the embedded event is not a beacon

rejected.name: tell-embedded-bad-signature
rejected.reason: the embedded beacon's signature does not verify

rejected.name: tell-embedded-bad-id
rejected.reason: the embedded beacon's id is wrong

rejected.name: tell-embedded-changed
rejected.reason: the embedded beacon was changed after signing

rejected.name: tell-embedded-expired
rejected.reason: the embedded beacon has expired, though the tell claims it has not

rejected.name: tell-expired
rejected.reason: the tell and its beacon have expired, though the tell is fresh

rejected.name: tell-embeds-another-seeders-beacon
rejected.reason: the tell's signer is not the beacon's

rejected.name: tell-signed-by-another-key
rejected.reason: the tell's signer is not the beacon's

rejected.name: tell-other-video
rejected.reason: the embedded beacon serves another video

rejected.name: tell-expiration-differs
rejected.reason: the tell's `expiration` is not the beacon's

rejected.name: tell-bad-id
rejected.reason: the id is not the NIP-01 hash

ignored.name: another-type
ignored.reason: a `t` this version does not use
